events.name: Bash
events.head: Check tasks.html for each fix
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; f=workshop-plan/tasks.html; grep -c $'—\|–' $f; grep -n 'STATIC\s*=\|static_mode\|staticMode\|plural\|aria-label="[^"]*"\s*id="\(nt-\|f-area\|f-status\|q\)\|YYYY-MM-DD\|stale\|reviewer' $f | cut -c1-220 | head -50; git log --oneline -6 -- $f

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check aria, kcard, static flag, probes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; f=workshop-plan/tasks.html; grep -no '<\(input\|select\|textarea\)[^>]*id="\(nt-[a-z]*\|f-area\|f-status\|q\)"[^>]*>' $f | sed 's/placeholder.*//' ; sed -n 572p $f | grep -o 'kcard.\{0,600\}' | grep -o 'rv\|Review[^<]*\|reviewers[^)]*)' | head; grep -n 'board-mode\|uploads' $f | cut -c1-200; grep -n 'board-mode\|static' workshop-plan/tasks/sync_board.py | head; grep -n 'stale\|plural\|board-mode\|static\|None\|dash\|YYYY\|aria' workshop-plan/probe-tasks.mjs workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs | cut -c1-180 | head -40

events.text: Most items are in place. Check kcard reviewers and the "None" fallback, then run both probes.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check kcard reviewers, None, AUDIT, server
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; f=workshop-plan/tasks.html; awk 'NR==572' $f | tr '<' '\n' | grep -i 'rev\|people' | head -5; grep -n '"None"\|>None<' $f | cut -c1-160 | head; grep -n 'kcard' workshop-plan/probe-tasks.mjs | cut -c1-200 | head -3; grep -n 'H041\|H045\|H048\|H049\|H050\|H051\|H052' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | grep -o '| H0[0-9]* .\{0,20\}\|[^|]*|\s*$' | paste - - | head -8; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8899/tasks.html

events.name: Bash
events.head: Verify commits and run both probes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; for c in 629678d 0dca6ec 78e6b4e; do git branch -a --contains $c 2>&1 | head -2 | tr '\n' ' '; git show --stat --format='%h %s' $c | grep -c 'tasks.html\|probe-\|sync_board'; done; git status --short workshop-plan/tasks.html workshop-plan/probe-*.mjs workshop-plan/tasks/sync_board.py; (node workshop-plan/probe-tasks.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4; node workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4; node workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs --live 2>&1 | tail -3)

events.name: Bash
events.head: See probe error details
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; node workshop-plan/probe-tasks.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v '^\s*at ' | tail -15; git show --stat --format='%h %s' 78e6b4e | head -12

events.text: Probes use relative paths; run from workshop-plan.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run both probes from workshop-plan
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; node probe-tasks.mjs > /tmp/t274a.log 2>&1; echo "tasks exit $?"; grep -ci 'fail\|✗' /tmp/t274a.log; tail -3 /tmp/t274a.log; node probe-public-board.mjs > /tmp/t274b.log 2>&1; echo "public exit $?"; tail -3 /tmp/t274b.log; node probe-public-board.mjs --live > /tmp/t274c.log 2>&1; echo "live exit $?"; tail -3 /tmp/t274c.log
